upstream_status.dispute_points: (1) The window is tiny: warps >=1 must finish the second call's 10-ish shuffles and store before warp 0 executes one shared load right after the barrier, so on hardware warp 0 effectively always wins; no wrong histogram has been reported. (3) Under the PTX model it is a plain WAR race between lane k of warp 0 (R) and lane 0 of warp k (W) with no bar/fence ordering.
